articles.title: Norway Fans Row Their Way to World Cup Fame!
articles.summary: Norwegian fans started a 'Viking Row' cheer on an escalator in Boston. Now even their parliament is doing it!

articles.title: Supreme Court Says Trump Can Deport People from Syria and Haiti
articles.summary: The Supreme Court ruled that President Trump can end protections for people from Syria and Haiti. Hundreds of thousands may have to leave.

articles.title: Gulf Countries Welcome US-Iran Deal After War
articles.summary: Gulf states like Saudi Arabia and Qatar are happy about a new US-Iran agreement. They want peace, not war.
